extracts the full 60x60 region grid for all baseline-window and target days from downloaded daily files. C12 builds per-cell hazen 90th-percentile thresholds from ±5-day pools and smooths them with a 31-day wrapped mean. Only threshold days of year 138–259 feed the target days (doy 153–244), so each baseline year contributes 12 May–20 Sep.
